artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a village scene. The horizon is near the upper third of the composition. Birds are flying on the right side. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes or etch lines, capturing architectural and natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white. In the foreground, two figures walk along a path, while a person fishes in a pond with ducks swimming. In the background, there is a stone building with a towering chimney, along with thatched-roof houses, hills, and sparse trees.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene with a cluster of thatched-roof cottages along the horizon. Sparse trees surround the cottages. The brushwork is detailed and precise, capturing textures in the rooftops and landscape with fine lines. The color palette is mostly sepia or brown. A small pond with grass at its edge is in the foreground, with livestock like cows and sheep and figures further in the distance. The sky has scattered clouds and a flock of birds.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with thatched-roof structures, trees, sky with clouds and birds in flight. The artwork features fine, detailed hatching and cross-hatching. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying shades of black ink on cream-colored paper. A lone figure with a stick is walking near chickens pecking around. Thatched structures are seen in the distance, completing the scene.

artworks.title: Road with Barn and Cottages
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with leafless trees, a path with small figures, cottages, and dense foliage on both sides. The fine, detailed etching technique highlights textures like thatch, foliage, and tree bark. The monochrome color palette creates a timeless aesthetic, emphasizing texture and form. The sky is neutral, enhancing the landscape's details.

artworks.title: Farms and Shed
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural village scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the composition, almost level with the roofs of the houses. Delicate lines depict detailed textures of thatched roofs and trees. The monochromatic color scheme features various shades of black and white. A cart with figures is seen on a path, leading towards more trees, houses, and figures. Further ahead, a person on horseback and others are visible. In the distance, rustic houses with thatched roofs and bare trees portray a tranquil village setting.

artworks.title: Village Road with Farm and Sheds
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with buildings, trees, and a dirt road. The horizon is obscured by the structures and tall trees. There are people along the road, including a child with a dog and a woman with children. The artwork shows detailed etchings with wispy brushstrokes, in a monochromatic color palette of gray and black.

artworks.title: Village Road
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape and village scene. The horizon line is high, with trees, rooftops, and distant structures depicted in simple, linear detail. The etching technique is seen in the fine lines defining the trees, buildings, and figures. Close to the viewer, people and animals are gathered on a path, with some appearing to converse or rest. In the background, houses with thatched roofs are surrounded by trees. The color palette is monochrome, with varying shades to create contrast and depth in the scene.

artworks.title: A Farmyard with a Draw Well
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The composition includes buildings, trees, and a horizon. The art style is detailed and expressive, with fine line work capturing textures. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing depth and form. The scene includes buildings with thatched roofs, trees, and a group of chickens. In the distance, more buildings and trees are visible, creating a small village in nature.

artworks.title: Farm and Row of Houses
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing two thatched cottages with figures engaged in various activities nearby. The horizon is softly indicated by lighter etching strokes in the sky, with scattered clouds. The scene has a rustic setting with a simple, monochromatic color palette of black ink on a light background. Brushstrokes define the texture of buildings, trees, and figures.

artworks.title: Village Street
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a rural scene from an elevated viewpoint. A winding dirt path is lined with thatched-roof cottages and trees. The horizon is obscured by the path and more trees, giving the impression of an endless road. The etching technique features fine lines showing detailed textures of the huts and tree leaves. A figure leads livestock, including cows and sheep, along the path. Two figures stand near trees on the left. The road curves past more cottages into the background where trees and their branches create patterns against the sky. The monochrome palette enhances the tranquil and pastoral atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Village Street
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a high horizon, featuring a village with thatched houses and trees. In the foreground, there are figures engaged in activity with a dog. The etching technique is used to create fine, linear strokes for texture and shadow. The color palette is primarily monochromatic with shades of gray and black. The intricate linework highlights the details of the cottages and foliage, creating a balanced composition.

artworks.title: Village Street
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a rural village scene with houses, trees, and people engaged in various activities. The style is intricate, with precise lines and shading in a black and white color palette. The sky features detailed clouds, contrasting with the village below.

artworks.title: Village Street
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a rural village scene with figures engaging in daily activities. Logs are arranged on the ground near the foreground. A path winds through thatched-roof cottages in the middle ground, with tall trees forming a canopy over the buildings in the background. The etching uses detailed linework and cross-hatching to depict textures, shadows, and depth. The scene has a monochromatic palette with an emphasis on contrast. The sky is left plain to focus on the village life within the landscape.

artworks.title: Farm
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with thatched-roof houses, bare trees, and figures performing tasks. The style appears to be an etching, with fine lines and cross-hatching to create texture and depth. The color scheme is monochrome with varying intensities of black ink on a tan background. In the background, birds can be seen in the sky.

artworks.title: Village Square with Shrine
artworks.artist: Carel Collaert
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is positioned high, close to the upper edge of the image, where gentle hills populate the scene. The style is monochromatic, with detailed line work capturing the texture of the houses' roofs and the trees. In the foreground, a few figures engage in activities, while a cart moves along a path, leading the eye deeper into the image where more houses and people can be seen.

artworks.title: The Swann's Inn with Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image features a rural landscape with thatched-roof structures scattered across. Two figures on horseback and a dog are depicted in motion, with logs lying on the ground to the left. The scene is rendered in fine lines, showcasing texture and detail in foliage and buildings. The color palette is monochrome, using black ink on a light background. In the distance, more figures are walking towards a central building.

artworks.title: Country Village
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a village setting with small buildings, leafless trees, a low horizon line, and birds in the sky. A bench is visible on a path, with figures positioned along it. The artwork features an etching technique with clear, linear strokes and cross-hatching, predominantly in black ink on a neutral background.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image is a straight-on view of a landscape. The horizon features thatched-roof cottages, trees, and a gap in the building pattern. The etching technique shows detailed line work with a monochrome color scheme of black and white. In the foreground, there is a cultivated field with rows and a small figure of a farmer. The background shows more trees, and the sky has subtle horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Farms in a Village
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural village scene with thatched-roof cottages, trees, and a person herding animals in an open landscape. The artwork features intricate line work in black and white, emphasizing textures and contrast. Gabled rooftops add to the village's serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Country Village with Sheep and Sitting Shepherd
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring a rustic village scene. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing a view of the village with trees and rooftops in the background. The etching is detailed with cross-hatching and fine lines defining the forms and textures of the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, with black lines on an off-white background. There are figures on horseback and walking, as well as pigs. Trees frame the houses in the distance. The sky has softly sketched clouds.

artworks.title: Village with Pond
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 16th Century
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a rural scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The scene includes a small village area with rustic structures, thatched roofs, wooden beams, rolling hills, clouds, figures herding animals, a pond with ducks, and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, and the engraving showcases detailed lines and hatching techniques.

artworks.title: Country Village with Church and Bridge
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a rural scene with a village landscape, including a thatched roof house, a church steeple, trees, and riverbank with figures. The etching features detailed linework with crosshatching for texture and depth. The scene shows people sitting near the river and in a boat. The overall color palette is monochromatic, with variations in line density creating contrast and depth.

artworks.title: Country Village with Post Mill
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a village, trees, a path, figures, a windmill, clouds in the sky, and a flock of birds. The village has thatched-roof cottages, and the trees are bare. The scene appears to be set in winter, with a snowy landscape. The artwork is created using fine etching lines and a monochromatic color palette of black and white.

artworks.title: Fields and a Village Road with Post Mill
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a rural landscape from an elevated viewpoint capturing a village scene. The horizon is high in the image, focusing on the village and farmlands. There are houses with a chimney emitting smoke and a windmill in the distance. The brushstroke style is detailed and delicate, typical of engravings with fine lines depicting textures like thatched roofs and fields. The color palette is monochrome with variations of black and white showing depth and texture. Close by, there are fields with a gate and figures and animals are seen on the village road in the distance.
